The requested service consists of two main deliverables:
1) provide online access to the required data in a reader-friendly way (summary by group of titles and/or by individual title), by customizing the database that the service provider owns
2) draft an analytical report based on the quantitative data, including a qualitative analysis on the differences in performance between the titles supported by Films on the Move and non-supported films and releases.
The subject of analysis is Creative Europe: MEDIA call Films on the Move, where distributors benefit from grants to run a larger-than-usual promotion campaign, coordinated across all participating territories to reap benefits of scale, for certain non-national European titles. The purpose of Films on the Move is to increase the audiences to European non-national films thanks to the high quality of the films but also intensive promotion. DG CNECT, which is in charge of the Creative Europe MEDIA Programme, wants to assess the effects of Films on the Move by analysing the data on consumption of the films supported. 
Regarding the (1) customization of the database, the database should include the following categories for analysis: 
-	The data should be provided for 4 categories of films:
o	The titles which received Films on the Move support (around 45 – their choice will be agreed between CNECT and contractor at the start of the contract)
o	The market average for all films released in cinemas in MEDIA countries in the given time frame 
o	The average result of a non-nationally-released film (majority co-) produced in one of countries participating in Creative Europe: MEDIA
o	The average result of a group of selected 10-20 films which are comparable to the titles supported by Films on the Move (similar number of appearances in festivals, nominations and awards). The 10-20 comparable films will be chosen together by the Contractor and DG CNECT at the start of the contract.
-	The performance data on the 4 categories of the films above should be provided preferably broken down for 4 types of geographic regions:
o	The country where it was (majority co-) produced
o	in each country where its distribution is supported by the grant
o	in the rest of the MEDIA-participating countries
o	in the rest of the world (all non-MEDIA participating countries where data is available) – with data also singled out for all available countries, especially US and UK.
-	The data should be provided for the following 3 exploitation windows:
o	Cinemas
	tickets sold in cinemas in general (and in Europa Cinemas in particular)
	number of screenings (and in Europa Cinemas in particular)
	whenever possible, length of regular cinema run (and in Europa Cinemas in particular)
o	TVOD including online services of broadcasters 
	Number of platforms where the title is available, split by local and international platforms
	Whenever possible, length of availability on TVOD platforms, split by local and international platforms
	Wherever possible, number of TVOD purchases, split by local and international platforms
o	SVOD including online services of broadcasters 
	Number of platforms where the title is available, split by local and international platforms
	Whenever possible, Length of availability on SVOD platforms, split by local and international platforms
	Wherever applicable/possible, number of views, split by local and international platforms

Title: Ireland – Festival organisation services – DCC Single Party Framework Agreement for the Supply, Installation, Maintenance, Removal and Storage of Artistic Lighting Illuminations and Associated Equipment
Procedure title: DCC Single Party Framework Agreement for the Supply, Installation, Maintenance, Removal and Storage of Artistic Lighting Illuminations and Associated Equipment
Description: Dublin City Council intends to establish a Single Party Framework Agreement with a suitably qualified service provider to deliver an initial contract for the Dublin Winter Lights Festival. The Dublin Winter Lights Festival has traditionally taken place primarily in outdoor venues and will continue to do so, while also exploring the idea of having some indoor experiences in 2027 and future years. Dublin City Council’s Dublin Winter Lights Festival has illuminated iconic landmarks and more unconventional locations previously, using a range of different projection methods, with more recent years seeing a trend towards full digital projections with locations such as the GPO, Custom House and Collins Barracks seeing full digital video mapping animations. By consistently seeking out innovative and unexpected sites, the festival has continued to evolve and stay fresh. It combines digital art, lighting design, and public performance to illuminate key cultural landmarks across the city, Note: the subject matter of this procurement relates to Title III Services as defined in Directive 2014/24/EU. Please note that this project is subject to funding. The framework agreement will be for a period of six (6) years. The Contracting Authority considers a framework term of six (6) years necessary due to the specialist nature of the services and the significant investment required by the successful Framework Member in artistic lighting infrastructure, projection equipment, storage facilities, specialist personnel, festival development and stakeholder relationships. The longer framework duration is intended to facilitate continuity of service, enable long-term planning and programming of the Dublin City Council Dublin Winter Lights Festival, support the development of artistic partnerships and innovation, and provide value for money through the amortisation of equipment and mobilisation costs over a longer period. The framework will also support the ongoing maintenance, storage and reuse of lighting infrastructure and associated equipment, contributing to sustainability objectives and reducing lifecycle costs. The duration is therefore justified by the subject matter of the framework and the need to secure consistent, high-quality delivery of a flagship cultural event and related artistic lighting projects. The Contracting Authority confirms that the period of any contracts awarded under the framework agreement may extend beyond the date of expiry of the agreement. Procedure title: Bereitstellung von zwei Cubesat-Satelliten und die Vorbereitung einer Kleinsatellitenmission
Description: Die Universität der Bundeswehr München (UniBw M) wurde 1973 auf Bestreben des damaligen Bundesministers der Verteidigung, Helmut Schmidt, unter dem Namen "Hochschule der Bundeswehr München" gegründet. Sie ist eine von zwei Universitäten, die die Bundeswehr zur Ausbildung ihrer Offiziersanwärter und jungen Offiziere hat. Die Universität gehört zum zivilen Organisationsbereich Personal und ist dem Bundesministerium der Verteidigung zugeordnet. Im Rahmen des vom dtec.bw geförderten Forschungsprojekts SeRANIS beabsichtigt die UniBw M die Bereitstellung von zwei Cubesat-Satelliten und Vorbereitung einer Kleinsatellitenmission zu beschaffen. Auftragsgegenstand ist die Bereitstellung von zwei Cubesat-Satelliten und die Vorbereitung einer Kleinsatellitenmission. Durch diese Kleinsatellitenmission möchte die UniBw M Teile der Experimentalnutzlast zusätzlich qualifizieren und testen. Mit den zwei entwickelten und bereitgestellten Cubesats sowie der Vorbereitung des Missionsbetriebs durch den Auftragnehmer führt die UniBw M anschließend eine vollständige Mission durch. Der Auftragnehmer muss die Kleinsatellitenmission vorbereiten. Dazu muss der Auftragnehmer mehrere Experimentalnutzlasten des Auftraggebers auf zwei Kleinsatelliten integrieren und einen Betrieb im Low Earth Orbit (LEO) ermöglichen. Der Auftragnehmer muss insbesondere folgende Leistungen erbringen: - Entwicklung und Produktion zweier Cubesat-Satelliten, - Integration der Nutzlasten des Auftraggebers auf den Satellitenplattformen, - Bereitstellung oder Vorbuchung eines Bodensegments, - Durchführung eines integrierten Missionstests vor dem Transport der Satelliten, - Vorbuchen des Starts.

Provision of Electric Drive Compressor package including: - Electric motor; and - Natural gas centrifugal compressor. 2. Provision of all ancillary supporting systems including: - Control system PLC 3.
